LESSON: REGIONAL CO- OPERATIONS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: POLITICAL SYSTEMS
Topic 4.2: Regional co- operations
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Regional co- operations, part of POLITICAL SYSTEMS in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can East African countries cooperate?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign terms related to Regional co-operations in Eastern Africa.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Regional co- operations in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the objectives of East African Community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Regional co- operations in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. describe the benefits of East African Community to member states,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Regional co- operations in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. identify the challenges facing the East African Community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Regional co- operations in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. formulate the possible solutions to challenges facing the East African Community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Regional co- operations in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

F. value the unity of Eastern African countries. ●

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Regional co- operations in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. sign terms related to Regional co-operations in Eastern Africa.

   Regional co- operations helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain the objectives of East African Community,

   Regional co- operations helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. describe the benefits of East African Community to member states,

   Regional co- operations helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. identify the challenges facing the East African Community,

   Regional co- operations helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. formulate the possible solutions to challenges facing the East African Community,

   Regional co- operations helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

F. value the unity of Eastern African countries. ●

   Regional co- operations helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Regional co- operations together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Peace: learners collaborate with others as they discuss the benefits of East African Community to member states and report in class.

● Integrity: learners apply laid down procedures as they discuss the benefits of East African Community to member states and report in

class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety and Security: learners use digital resources to make presentations in class on the research findings.

• Social Cohesion: learners brainstorm, in groups, the member states of the East African Community and do a class presentation

Link to other Learning Areas:

• Creative Arts: learners share experiences as they draw and color the map of East Africa.

• English/Kiswahili/Kenya Sign Language: learners relate to skills learnt in English, Kiswahili and Kenya Sign Language as they sing the

East Africa Community anthem

Print and electronic maps, internet sources, vetted digital resources, adapted learner’ s books and other printed resources, resource persons,

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:

1. sign terms related to Regional co-operations in Eastern Africa.
2. explain the objectives of East African Community,
3. describe the benefits of East African Community to member states,
4. identify the challenges facing the East African Community,
5. formulate the possible solutions to challenges facing the East African Community,
6. value the unity of Eastern African countries. ●

Remember the key question: How can East African countries cooperate?
